name: media-meta-mcp
description: Local-first MCP server reading EXIF/XMP metadata from modern image formats: HEIC/HEIF/AVIF (ISOBMFF item metadata) and WebP (RIFF chunks). Zero runtime dependencies in the engine, zero network, zero LLM, no hosted gateway.

tools.name: image_metadata_read
tools.description: Read EXIF (IFD0/Exif/GPS) and XMP from a local HEIC/HEIF/AVIF/WebP image. Returns container, brand, grouped tags, XMP packet, and box/chunk list. Pure local byte parsing.
